title.zh: 有理等离子体色散极点

summary: Return ordered J4/J8 tables or the precision-corrected J12/I16/K8 pole-residue table.

capability: Return ordered J4/J8 tables or the precision-corrected J12/I16/K8 pole-residue table.
discovery.model: Explicit rational approximation or two-Gaussian representation for magnetized kinetic response.
discovery.geometry: Cartesian k=(kx,0,kz), B0 along signed z; non-spatial representation for pole/partition operators.
discovery.boundary: Uniform/local plane-wave response; no spatial boundary-value problem or nonlinear saturation.

identity.definition: Z_J(z)=sum_j bzj[j]/(z-czj[j]); paired tables obey sum b=-1,sum bc=0,sum bc^2=-1/2 within binary64 precision. J12 stores 80-digit construction metadata and binary64 coefficients; the historical 120-digit comparison is historical-unbound UNKNOWN. The J4/J8 tabulated values are kept as given.
identity.model: Explicit rational approximation or two-Gaussian representation for magnetized kinetic response.
identity.geometry: Cartesian k=(kx,0,kz), B0 along signed z; non-spatial representation for pole/partition operators.
identity.coordinates: SI angular frequency rad/s and wave number m^-1; normalized source scan/selection quantities are labeled explicitly.
identity.boundary: Uniform/local plane-wave response; no spatial boundary-value problem or nonlinear saturation.
assumptions: Caller retains the explicit truncation, state provenance and normalization.

inputs.name: J
inputs.description: Number of rational terms in Z(z)=sum_j bzj/(z-czj).
inputs.constraints: Exactly4,8 or12; J12/I16/K8 table is intentionally regenerated at high precision and rounded to binary64.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: J-pole table object; access J, bzj and czj through result.state.
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned operator result.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

preconditions: J in{4,8,12}; causal physical mapping must still handle the sign of parallel k.
supported: J in{4,8,12}; causal physical mapping must still handle the sign of parallel k.
excluded: Global nonlinear plasma evolution and a guarantee of unique physical mode identification.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Declared Python guards raise ValueError; unsupported J is rejected without a table fallback.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Pure Python numeric errors propagate with operation context; no the reference runtime or source-runtime process is invoked.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iterative solve is performed by fixed-table lookup; J12 construction is validated by the separate pure mpmath Padé operator.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned when validation or table loading fails.

example.description: Return a pure-Python J-pole table and inspect its moments.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.dispersion import magnetized
r = magnetized.pole_coefficients(8)
assert r.state['bzj'].size == 8
example.expected: The call returns a state object whose bzj table has J entries; the example executes locally without an external runtime.

scope: test_regenerated_j12_preserves_asymptotic_moments directly checks sum b=-1, sum bc=0 and sum bc^2=-1/2 within 1e-10 for ES1D, ES3D and EM J12 tables.

historical-unbound UNKNOWN: installed-package closure, all-12-API qualification, the full 50-point N10/J8 run and 80/120-digit independent comparison receipts are not bound here. Package metadata and construction capability do not prove those historical executions; supported calculation and the named direct assertions are retained.
The same three asymptotic moment identities asserted at 1e-12 absolute for the J4, J8 and J12 tables returned by pole_coefficients.
A 40-digit definition comparison of the rational sum with a ceiling fixed from the pole count before measurement: 1e-1 for the four-pole table and 1e-5 for the eight- and twelve-pole tables.
verification.evidence_ceiling: test_pole_table_evidence.py applies the moment identities to all three declared tables and compares each rational sum with the 40-digit Maxwellian Z on six upper-half-plane points. The per-table ceilings come from the retained pole count, not from the data: four poles are held to 1e-1 and eight or more to 1e-5. The J12 table is a regenerated high-precision reconstruction rounded to binary64; the historical 120-digit comparison remains unbound and is not used as evidence. No continuous-domain or lower-half-plane claim is established.
known_limitations: Local technical development; human scientific endorsement and publication clearance remain pending.
Finite harmonic N and rational-pole J approximations require independent convergence checks for a new physical regime.
Passing bounded response, state and backward-error tests does not establish unique physical-mode tracking, all-root forward accuracy or visual acceptance.
Lower-half-plane poles define a rational approximation; its global strong-damping accuracy is not established by bounded upper-half-plane response tests.
Historical qualification is unbound (UNKNOWN); current direct checks and bounded examples neither impose a new platform restriction nor certify arbitrary parameter regimes.
The four-pole table cannot be held below 1e-1 relative on the sampled upper half plane; that is a property of a four-term rational approximation, not a defect of the reader.
The J12 table is a regenerated high-precision reconstruction rounded to binary64; the historical 120-digit comparison remains unbound and is not evidence here.

basis.statement: The poles are compared to 1e-5. The J12 table is a regenerated high-precision reconstruction rounded to binary64; the historical 120-digit comparison remains unbound and is NOT used as evidence. No continuous-domain or lower-half-plane claim is established.

references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).
